title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 33
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 33: the blessing Moses spoke over the tribes of Israel before his death.

questions.text: From where did Yahweh come, according to the start of Moses' blessing?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says: "Yahweh came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran."

questions.text: What does Moses say about Reuben?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says: "Let Reuben live, and not die; nor let his men be few."

answers.text: He is a lion's cub that leaps out of Bashan
He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm
Let him be acceptable to his brothers
Let him live, and not die; nor let his men be few

questions.text: About which tribe does Moses say, "Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one"?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 begins: "About Levi he said, 'Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one.'"

questions.text: What does Moses say about Benjamin?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says: "The beloved of Yahweh will dwell in safety by him."

answers.text: The beloved of Yahweh will dwell in safety by him
He is satisfied with favor, full of Yahweh's blessing
He will call the peoples to the mountain
He provided the first part for himself

questions.text: Joseph's horns are compared to the horns of what?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 speaks of "the head of Joseph," and verse 17 says: "His horns are the horns of the wild ox."

questions.text: Which tribe is told to rejoice "in your tents"?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says: "Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents."
Verse 22 says: "Dan is a lion's cub that leaps out of Bashan."

answers.text: A lion's cub that leaps out of Bashan
An eagle that flutters over its young
A deer that runs on the high mountains
A wild donkey that roams the desert

questions.text: Which tribe does Moses say should "dip his foot in oil"?
questions.explanation: Verse 24 says about Asher: "Let him dip his foot in oil."

questions.text: According to verse 27, what is underneath?
questions.explanation: Verse 27 says: "The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms."

questions.text: How does Moses describe Israel at the end of the blessing?
questions.explanation: Verse 29 says: "You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by Yahweh?"

answers.text: A people scattered among the nations
A people who live in tents forever
